name: Global-Dependent Local Constraint
description: Rewrote the local pairwise constraint so that it mathematically references the global sum of the sequence ($S$). Because of the domain bounds ($c_i \in \{1,2,3\}$ and $n \ge 2$), it algebraically simplifies to a pure local inequality ($c_u \neq c_v$). Models that fail to deduce this simplification will attempt to check the constraint globally (causing TLE on $O(3^N)$ backtracking) or struggle to feed non-linear modulo operations into a solver, defeating the precomputation shortcut.
